title: Power outage
label: UTILITIES
deck: Protect people, preserve essentials, and avoid the hidden hazards of a blackout.
tldr: Deal first with essential medical power, unsafe heat or cold, and drinking water. Use battery light, conserve phone power and keep fridge doors closed. Assume restoration may take longer than expected. Run generators outdoors at least 20 feet from openings; never heat a home with an oven, grill or indoor generator. Relocate early if you cannot maintain essential care or safe temperature.
steps: Find the outage map and local emergency alerts. If someone depends on powered medical equipment, use the backup plan and seek urgent help if that equipment cannot run.
Use flashlights rather than candles. Keep refrigerators and freezers closed. Unplug sensitive electronics if power is unstable, and leave one light on to show when service returns.
A generator, camp stove, grill, or vehicle can produce deadly carbon monoxide. Keep fuel-burning equipment outside and well away from openings; use a battery-powered CO alarm if available.
Contact neighbors who may need help. Conserve phone power, use text when calls are congested, and monitor official updates.
next: If the outage continues, plan for safe temperature, water, medication refrigeration, and a place to relocate if the home becomes unsafe. Check current food-safety advice before eating perishables after a prolonged outage.
watch: Headache, dizziness, weakness, nausea, or confusion near fuel-burning equipment can signal carbon monoxide exposure. Get into fresh air and call emergency services. Never enter a flooded area to operate electrical equipment.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Assume restoration time is uncertain. Reserve battery power for medical equipment, light and short check-ins, keep fridge doors closed and inventory safe water. If essential medical support or safe temperature cannot be maintained, move to a checked safer place early rather than waiting for an estimate.
household: Write down water, food, battery and medication needs for each person. Keep clean and dirty containers separate and preserve essential power before entertainment. Agree on the point at which lack of water, medical support or safe temperature means you must relocate.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
